baseline.description: Current TUI state as of May 2026, based on full code audit of src/ui/tui.rs (1029 lines) and src/ui/mod.rs.
baseline.framework: ratatui + crossterm, Rust async (tokio), broadcast event bus

layout.mode_switching: Flat state: live view vs results view, toggled by presence of final_report

keybindings.s: save report (live view only — absent from results view)

stability_gaps: No minimum terminal size guard — renders garbled on tiny windows (<80x24).
No terminal resize event handling — layout does not reflow after resize.
Only one error slot (last_error: Option<String>) — a second error silently overwrites the first.
`s` (save) only active during live run; footer hides the hint in results view, even though save_report() works fine at that point.
save_flash_span uses Instant::elapsed which is correct, but the flash is only cleared on the next render tick; no explicit cancel path.
UiEvent::Error has no emit site in the engine yet — dead variant, but TUI already renders it.
visual_consistency_gaps: All colors hardcoded inline as ratatui::style::Color literals (Cyan, Magenta, Green, Yellow, Red, DarkGray, Rgb(184,134,11)) — no semantic abstraction layer.
No $NO_COLOR / $COLORTERM detection — always renders with full color regardless of environment.
Sparkline has no scale annotation — user cannot read the Y-axis magnitude.
Latency table column widths are fixed Constraint::Length values; can overflow or waste space on narrow/wide terminals.
Finished phase card title uses raw Unicode ✓ (U+2713); in-progress title uses LIVE label without a visual pulse/animation to indicate activity.
No visual separator or distinct styling between completed-phase cards and the active phase block.
Summary card bottom line uses ⇣ / ⇡ symbols that may not render on restricted ANSI terminals.
helpfulness_gaps: No ? help overlay — keybinding discoverability relies entirely on the 3-char footer.
Footer shows only `q quit · s save report`; there is no hint that ? exists.
Header shows elapsed / total time but no overall session progress percentage or ETA.
TUI latency panel omits jitter (stdev) column shown in the plain renderer — information regression.
Latency sparkline history absent — no visual trend for RTT over the session lifetime.
Waiting placeholder text ('waiting for first phase…') is passive and gives no indication the tool is actively connecting or measuring idle latency.
No indication of how many latency probes have been collected vs total planned (count is shown but not as a progress fraction).
No live throughput peak annotation on sparkline (no max-so-far marker).

key_findings.progressive_disclosure: Footer shows 3-5 critical keys always. `?` shows full keybinding overlay on demand. Documentation handles the power-user ceiling. Users should never need to read a manual to get started.
key_findings.semantic_color: Define colors by function (status.success, status.error, accent.primary) not appearance. Enables overnight theme-swapping. The three-tier model: design first for 16 ANSI colors, then 256, then true color. Strip all color when $NO_COLOR is set.
key_findings.spatial_consistency: Panels don't move. The user's spatial memory is their navigation. Every layout reshuffle resets mental maps to zero.
key_findings.resize_guard: Minimum 80x24 guard with a clear human-readable message. Handle terminal resize events so layout reflows gracefully rather than rendering stale geometry.
key_findings.async_ui: Never freeze the UI. Every background operation must have a visible progress indicator. User must always be able to reach Esc/q and get a responsive interface.

vim_keybinding_layers.L0_universal: Arrow keys, Enter, Escape, q to quit — always shown in footer
vim_keybinding_layers.L1_vim: j/k/h/l, /, ?, g/G — shown in footer for terminal natives
vim_keybinding_layers.L2_actions: Mnemonic single keys (s=save, r=refresh) — discoverable through ? overlay

key_findings.information_density: Every cell earns its place. Use fractional block chars (▏▎▍▌▋▊▉█) and braille overlays for sub-cell precision in charts. Status indicators use semantic symbols: ● online, ○ offline, ◐ transitioning.
key_findings.reactive_over_polling: Prefer reactive push (tokio::watch, broadcast) over timer polling for data freshness — the codebase already uses this pattern correctly.
key_findings.layout_patterns: For a speed-test monitor dashboard, 'Widget Dashboard' or 'Header + Scrollable List' is the closest match. Spatial consistency means the latency panel is always in the same position.

applied_to_speedt.layout_classification: Header + Scrollable List with a pinned footer — already close to the right pattern.
applied_to_speedt.biggest_information_gap: Jitter missing from TUI latency panel (present in plain renderer) and no latency trend sparkline.
applied_to_speedt.color_architecture_priority: Extract semantic color constants before adding more color-dependent features to avoid a hex-code sprawl problem.
applied_to_speedt.resize_handling_urgency: High — narrow terminals silently garble the layout today.

improvements.title: Minimum terminal size guard + resize handling
improvements.description: Check terminal dimensions on every render tick. When width < 80 or height < 24, replace the full layout with a single centered message ('Terminal too small — resize to at least 80×24'). Handle crossterm Event::Resize by triggering an immediate redraw so the layout reflows rather than showing stale geometry.
improvements.rationale: Prevents garbled renders on narrow windows; resize is an L0 stability concern.

improvements.title: Error ring buffer (replace single last_error slot)
improvements.description: Replace `last_error: Option<String>` in State with `errors: VecDeque<String>` capped at 3. Render all accumulated errors in the footer (scrolling if needed). Second error no longer silently replaces the first.
improvements.rationale: A second network error during a session currently overwrites the first, hiding failure history.

improvements.title: Enable `s` save in results view + footer hint parity
improvements.description: In the results view branch of run_loop, add the KeyAction::Save handler and show the `s  save report` span in the footer. Currently save is hidden from the user once the session finishes, even though build_partial_report + save work fine at that point.
improvements.rationale: Users who want to save after reviewing results currently have no affordance for it.

improvements.title: Semantic color constants module
improvements.description: Create a `theme` module (or submodule of ui) with named Style constants: STYLE_DOWNLOAD, STYLE_UPLOAD, STYLE_SUCCESS, STYLE_WARN, STYLE_ERROR, STYLE_MUTED, STYLE_EMPHASIS, STYLE_KEY_HINT. Replace all inline color literals in tui.rs with these constants. Also add a `no_color()` fn that returns Style::default() when $NO_COLOR is set, and thread it through all styled spans.
improvements.rationale: 23 inline color literals today. Without a semantic layer, adding theming or $NO_COLOR support later requires grepping 50 call sites. Semantic constants enable overnight theme swaps.

improvements.title: $NO_COLOR / color-tier detection
improvements.description: At TUI startup, check std::env::var('NO_COLOR'). If set, use Style::default() everywhere (monochrome mode). Optionally check $COLORTERM for 'truecolor'/'24bit' to enable Rgb() color slots; fall back to named ANSI colors otherwise. This makes the app work cleanly over SSH on 16-color connections.
improvements.rationale: Professional courtesy; also required for accessibility and CI environments.

improvements.title: Latency RTT sparkline in latency panel
improvements.description: Add a small (1-row) sparkline widget below the latency table showing idle RTT trend across the session. Buffer idle_rtts_us already accumulates samples; derive a sparkline from the last min(width, N) samples. This gives a visual trend that numbers alone don't convey (e.g. a spike mid-session).
improvements.rationale: The throughput panel has a sparkline; the latency panel has only a static table. Adding RTT trend closes the visual parity gap.

improvements.title: Sparkline scale annotation
improvements.description: Add a one-character right-margin annotation to the throughput sparkline showing the current max value in the visible window (e.g. '↑ 482 Mbps'). Renders as a styled Span to the right of the sparkline block. Prevents the sparkline from being uninterpretable when scale shifts dramatically.
improvements.rationale: A sparkline without a scale is decoration, not information.

improvements.title: ? help overlay
improvements.description: Add a `help_visible: bool` field to State. Pressing `?` toggles it. When true, draw a centered popup over the current layout listing all keybindings in two columns (key | description). Include: q=quit, s=save, ?=toggle help, Ctrl-C=interrupt. Dismiss with `?`, `q`, or Escape.
improvements.rationale: Progressive disclosure is the #1 missing UX surface. Without ?, keybinding discoverability relies entirely on a 3-char footer label.

improvements.title: ? hint in footer
improvements.description: Add `·  ?  help` to the footer spans (between `s save report` and the save flash). Makes the help overlay discoverable at a glance. The key hint uses the same STYLE_KEY_HINT as `q` and `s`.
improvements.rationale: A help overlay that nobody knows exists provides zero value.

improvements.title: Overall session progress % in header
improvements.description: In draw_header, add an overall progress ratio (elapsed / total_planned_secs) formatted as a percentage alongside the clock. Optionally add a thin overall progress bar to the header block. During results view, show '100%  complete' instead.
improvements.rationale: Users running `speedt deep` (5-min session) want a quick glance at how far along they are without doing mental math on the clock display.

improvements.title: Jitter column in TUI latency panel
improvements.description: Add a 'jitter' column (stdev_ms from LatencySummary) to the TUI latency table. The plain renderer already shows this; the TUI currently omits it — a regression in information density. Adjust column widths via Constraint::Min / Constraint::Length to fit.
improvements.rationale: Jitter is a primary network quality signal. Omitting it from the TUI while showing it in plain mode creates a confusing information gap.

improvements.title: Latency probe count progress in latency panel
improvements.description: Replace the bare count column ('n') with a fraction showing collected vs planned probes (e.g. '42/60') for idle latency. Requires plumbing total probe count through UiEvent::SessionStarted or a new dedicated event.
improvements.rationale: Context for how much data backs the current latency estimate makes results more trustworthy during the run.
